nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned.owner).

SafeMath addition helper using an overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction helper using an underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication helper using require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division helper requiring a non-zero divisor.
Owned constructor setting owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function that sets the pending newOwner address.
Two-step ownership transfer acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner then swaps owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor initializing symbol/name/decimals and assigning the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer; debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without checking the current allowance value.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' debiting both the balance and the allowance of msg.sender.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction; state is written before the external call.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by this contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits, allowances and callback forwarding.
External call to an attacker-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval inside approveAndCall (reentrancy vector).
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract (reentrancy vector).
Raw arithmetic operations (a+b, a-b, a*b, a/b) inside SafeMath guarded by require checks against overflow/underflow.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner during the Owned constructor, granting all subsequent onlyOwner privileges.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing a pending owner change.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before swapping ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller-supplied token amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keying the allowance on the caller.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], so the spender identity derives from msg.sender.
approveAndCall both keys the allowance on msg.sender and forwards msg.sender into the external callback.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call.
transferOwnership reads owner state to authorize the caller.
Constructor writes the deployer address into owner.
transferOwnership stores _newOwner into the pending newOwner slot.
Parameter _newOwner is consumed by transferOwnership.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, transferring full control.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the ownership swap.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor mints the entire supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the hardcoded address with the whole supply in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply in its return expression.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry.
transfer reads and writes the balances ledger.
transfer delegates the sender debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry with the new value.
transferFrom mutates the balances ledger of 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements the nested allowance of msg.sender.
transferFrom uses safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
allowance returns the nested allowed mapping entry.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
Parameter 'to' selects the credited balance entry in transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' is the amount moved by transfer.

Parameter tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter 'from' selects the debited balance and allowance entry.
Parameter 'to' selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is the first index of the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender is the second index of the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender keys the allowance and becomes the callee contract address.
Parameter tokens is both the allowance and the amount forwarded to the callback.
Attacker-controlled bytes payload is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
transferOwnership writes the parameter to storage.
approveAndCall synchronously invokes the untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval.
The untrusted spender can re-enter the token contract (transferFrom/approveAndCall) during the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
A malicious token contract could re-enter owner-protected or transfer logic during the external transfer.
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary external token transfer to the owner.
Parameter tokenAddress is cast to ERC20Interface and called externally.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
safeAdd performs a + b and relies on require(c >= a) to block overflow.
safeSub performs a - b and relies on require(b <= a) to block underflow.
safeMul performs a * b and relies on the division check to block overflow.
safeDiv performs a / b and requires a non-zero divisor.
